messages:
mara: 🎭 Curtain call! We just passed 3,000,000 monthly requests — unreal. Big thank you to everyone!!

devon: WHOA!!! :tada: :confetti_ball:

sam: Donuts + sparkling water in kitchen right now :doughnut: :tada:

anya: I'll bring a tiny speaker for a 'triumph' fanfare 😂

paul: Can we do a 3-minute improv toast at 3:15? I'll MC.

mara: Love it. Quick photos for socials after. @marketing ping?

ops-bot: Notice: rolling restart deferred — enjoy the celebration :party_parrot:

devon: Stickers? Limited-edition “3M” stickers would be sick.

anya: I'll make a tiny “3M” sticker run today. Stickers + battery-safe sparkler props?

sam: OMG sparkler props are dramatic, approve :raised_hands:

paul: Team selfie at 3:20 then? Also bring your best improv line.

mara: Thank you all for pushing—this is huge. Remote folks, we'll ship you a care pack. :heart:

devon: Shoutout to infra for the late-night tuning last week. Legend status.

infra-hero: (bot) Appreciated — check #eng-releases for the technical writeup later!

anya: Also tiny poll — coffee or cider for the toast? React with :coffee: or :wine_glass:

sam: :coffee:

devon: :wine_glass:

mara: :coffee: preferred so it's early-appropriate. See y'all in 20!
